_doc: Ban khai hop dong mo hinh. Field chi ton tai neu it nhat mot mo hinh goi ten no trong input/input_phu/output/doi_chieu. Xem tools/README.md muc 'Hop dong mo hinh'.

emp.chieu_dau: EMP > 0 = cau USD vuot cung chinh thuc; EMP am = suc ep nguoc
emp.cham_diem: so bien dong fx.nhnn_tc 5 phien sau dau hieu EMP

gap_ccs.ten: Gap CCS - chenh lai suat VND/USD theo ky han
gap_ccs.cong_thuc: lai suat VND ky han t - lai suat USD lien ngan hang ky han t
gap_ccs.chieu_dau: Fed tang -> leg USD len -> gap hep; bom VND -> leg VND xuong -> gap hep
gap_ccs.nguong: gap 1M duoi 1,0 = ap luc chuyen sang ty gia; tren 3,0 = carry hap dan
gap_ccs.cham_diem: so gap du bao voi quote desk phien ke tiep
gap_ccs.ghi_chu: Tan suat theo input cham nhat: duong cong 3M/6M chi co quote tuan, du O/N co hang ngay. Muon theo doi O/N hang ngay thi tach mo hinh gap_ccs_on rieng.

cd_macro.ten: C/D Macro - ty le tin dung tren huy dong cap he thong
cd_macro.cong_thuc: du no tin dung / tien gui khach hang, cap he thong
cd_macro.chieu_dau: C/D tang -> ap luc huy dong -> COF len
cd_macro.nguong: KHONG dong nhat voi LDR phap ly TT22 (85%); C/D macro tren 100% la binh thuong
cd_macro.cham_diem: so uoc tinh voi so NHNN cong bo quy sau

kb_hormuz.cong_thuc: bon nhanh xac suat, moi nhanh neo mot dai Brent va mot dai ty gia
kb_hormuz.chieu_dau: xac suat dich sang KB-C/D -> Brent len -> war premium len
kb_hormuz.nguong: tai dinh vi kich ban khi Brent ra khoi dai cua KB hien hanh 5 phien lien tiep
kb_hormuz.cham_diem: Brent thuc te roi vao dai nao so voi KB dang dat
kb_hormuz.ghi_chu: hormuz.tau_ngay va oil.hormuz_tau la hai ban ghi cua cung mot so UKMTO (122 ra / 155 vao, 31/10) voi hai chuoi source khac nhau. Gop ve oil.hormuz_tau ngay 23/11.

war_premium.ten: Phan bu chien tranh tren gia dau
war_premium.chieu_dau: premium thu hep -> thi truong chiet khau rui ro dia chinh tri
war_premium.nguong: base_brent 73 USD; premium tren 25 USD = dinh gia kich ban KB-D
war_premium.cham_diem: so fair_brent voi Brent binh quan 20 phien sau
war_premium.ghi_chu: Ha tu CORE xuong WEEKLY ngay 26/11 theo dung quy tac 'tan suat = tan suat cong bo cua input cham nhat'. oil.brent lay tu chuoi gia GIAO NGAY cua EIA, cong bo tre 2-4 ngay (do 26/11: quan sat moi nhat la 24/11). Co the giu CORE neu doi sang hop dong tuong lai cua CNBC — co hang ngay — nhung do la CONG CU KHAC, lech 2-3% so gia giao ngay va se tao mot buoc nhay gia khong phai bien dong thi truong. Chon giu nguyen chuoi so.

cpi_passthrough.ten: Truyen dan gia dau va cuoc van tai sang CPI (mo hinh BCT 2 kenh)
cpi_passthrough.cong_thuc: kenh cost-push qua MOPS Singapore va kenh cuoc container
cpi_passthrough.chieu_dau: Brent len -> xang len sau 1-2 ky dieu hanh -> CPI len sau 1-2 thang
cpi_passthrough.nguong: muc tieu CPI 4,5%; vuot 2 thang lien tiep = pha dieu kien A1
cpi_passthrough.cham_diem: so CPI du bao voi so Cuc Thong ke cong bo thang sau

cof_4tang.ten: Bon tang lai suat huy dong - cau truc chi phi von
cof_4tang.cong_thuc: phan tang Big4 / tu nhan lon / tu nhan vua / nhom dinh thi truong
cof_4tang.chieu_dau: gian cach Big4 - nhom dinh noi rong -> ap luc huy dong phan tan
cof_4tang.nguong: CV 9736: cat 0,5dpt tren lai suat binh quan khoan moi tu 6 thang so nen 11-20/10
cof_4tang.cham_diem: so lai suat niem yet thuc te voi du bao dau ky

nsfr_lcr.cong_thuc: hai ty le an toan thanh khoan, hieu luc 01/12/2026
nsfr_lcr.chieu_dau: siet NSFR -> cau von trung dai han -> lai suat tu 6 thang len
nsfr_lcr.nguong: hieu luc 01/12/2026; co che dang ky tu nguyen theo Dieu 13
nsfr_lcr.cham_diem: so du bao dich chuyen duong cong huy dong voi thuc te sau 01/12

signal_a.ten: Signal A1/A2/A3 - dieu kien noi chinh sach
signal_a.cong_thuc: A1: CPI duoi 4% hai thang. A2: Fed khong tang VA DXY duoi 103 VA EMP on. A3: O/N duoi 6% qua hai tuan. Can dat tu hai tren ba.
signal_a.chieu_dau: dat tu 2/3 -> xac suat noi tang
signal_a.nguong: A1 CPI <= 4,0% hai thang lien tiep; A2 DXY < 103; A3 O/N < 6,0% hai tuan
signal_a.cham_diem: so trang thai tin hieu voi hanh dong thuc te cua NHNN trong 30 ngay

irp_covered.ten: Interest Rate Parity co bao hiem
irp_covered.chieu_dau: gap lai suat rong -> diem forward len
irp_covered.nguong: lech gia swap NHNN so voi IRP ly thuyet tren 0,5dpt = co tro cap hoac phat
irp_covered.cham_diem: so gia swap du bao voi gia NHNN chao phien ke tiep

hqla_transform.ten: HQLA transformation - swap va OMO cung ho
hqla_transform.cong_thuc: doi cau truc tai san thanh khoan, khong doi nang luc bang can doi
hqla_transform.chieu_dau: bom du -> O/N ve duoi tran OMO; bom thieu -> O/N vuot tran du co swap
hqla_transform.nguong: DAT khi O/N binh quan duoi 4,50%; KHONG DAT khi vuot 5,0%; that bai ro khi vuot 5,5%
hqla_transform.cham_diem: O/N binh quan ky thue so voi nguong tren
hqla_transform.ghi_chu: Tan suat theo input cham nhat: omo.trang_thai la so tuan va omo.fx_swap_182d la su kien, du O/N va OMO luu hanh co hang ngay. Dat CORE o ban khai dau la sai quy tac chinh minh dat ra.

bop_fx.ten: Can can thanh toan thay can can thuong mai de du bao ty gia
bop_fx.cong_thuc: BOP = can can vang lai + von + sai sot; dong tien that khac dong hang hoa
bop_fx.chieu_dau: BOP am -> du tru giam -> ap luc ty gia len
bop_fx.nguong: du tru duoi 3 thang nhap khau = han che du dia can thiep
bop_fx.cham_diem: so huong BOP du bao voi so NHNN cong bo quy sau

kbnn_liquidity.ten: Co che ngan quy nha nuoc - tac dong len thanh khoan he thong
kbnn_liquidity.cong_thuc: thu NSNN vuot chi -> tien dong tai KBNN -> rut khoi M2 -> siet TT2
kbnn_liquidity.chieu_dau: chenh thu-chi noi rong -> O/N len
kbnn_liquidity.nguong: dong tren 250k ty = ap luc thay duoc tren duong cong TT2
kbnn_liquidity.cham_diem: so du bao huong O/N voi thuc te thang sau

transmission_tt1.ten: Truyen dan tren thi truong lien ngan hang
transmission_tt1.cong_thuc: he so truyen dan tu O/N sang cac ky han dai hon
transmission_tt1.chieu_dau: he so am keo dai -> duong cong dut gay -> bom OMO khong toi ky han dai
transmission_tt1.nguong: he so moc 3 thang duy tri duoi 0,3 = truyen dan dut

dong_tien_rong.ten: Inside/outside money - dong tien rong vao he thong
dong_tien_rong.cong_thuc: inside money (tin dung) + outside money (DTC, NFA) - rut rong
dong_tien_rong.chieu_dau: dong rong am -> thanh khoan he thong co lai du tin dung tang
dong_tien_rong.nguong: tham hut tren 1.000k ty luy ke = can bom bu qua OMO hoac mua ngoai te
dong_tien_rong.cham_diem: so huong du bao thanh khoan voi O/N thang sau
dong_tien_rong.ghi_chu: GIOI HAN DU LIEU (chuyen tu field m2.data_limit, bo 23/11): NHNN cong bo M2 va co cau tien gui theo QUY, khong real-time. So chinh thuc gan nhat T3/2026 (dan cu 10.560k + TCKT 6.010k = 16.570k ty). Moi so M2 trong ky hien hanh deu la uoc tinh.

turn_basis.ten: Hieu ung chuyen nam tren duong cong ky han
turn_basis.cong_thuc: phan bu ky han chua thoi diem 31/12
turn_basis.chieu_dau: turn di chuyen vao bac ngan hon khi gan cuoi nam
turn_basis.cham_diem: chua co quy tac cham - can bo sung

hieu_ung_nen.ten: Hieu ung nen trong so sanh CPI
hieu_ung_nen.cong_thuc: so sanh CPI YoY theo nen cung ky nam truoc
hieu_ung_nen.chieu_dau: nen thap -> YoY phong len du MoM khong doi
hieu_ung_nen.nguong: khong co nguong - la hieu chinh doc so
hieu_ung_nen.cham_diem: khong cham rieng - di kem cpi_passthrough

scorecard.ten: Vong phan hoi - cham diem du bao
scorecard.cong_thuc: moi muc du bao gan mot model_id, cham dung/sai sau khi co so thuc te
scorecard.chieu_dau: ty le dung theo mo hinh quyet dinh mo hinh nao o lai ban 2027
scorecard.nguong: mo hinh duoi 50% dung sau 20 muc cham = dua ra xem xet bo
scorecard.cham_diem: tu no la co che cham
scorecard.ghi_chu: CAN BO SUNG: moi muc du bao phai mang model_id de quy ty le dung ve tung mo hinh

reer.ten: Ty gia thuc hieu luc theo ro thuong mai
reer.cong_thuc: REER = tich co trong so cua ty gia song phuong hieu chinh lam phat theo ro doi tac
input_can_co: ro tien te doi tac theo trong so XNK
ty gia song phuong tung dong
reer.chieu_dau: REER len = VND len gia thuc = giam canh tranh xuat khau
reer.nguong: chua dat - can dung xong moi dat
reer.trang_thai: THIEU NGUON - da hai lan phai dung ty gia song phuong VND/USD thay the va phai tu dinh chinh

gold_premium.ten: Chenh lech vang SJC so voi gia the gioi quy doi
gold_premium.cong_thuc: gold.sjc_ban - gold.tg_usd quy doi theo fx.vcb_ban
gold_premium.chieu_dau: premium noi rong = cau tru an trong nuoc tang, cung huong voi EMP
gold_premium.nguong: premium tren 15 trieu dong/luong = cau tru an bat thuong
gold_premium.cham_diem: so huong premium voi huong EMP trong 10 phien
gold_premium.ghi_chu: CAN BO SUNG: chua co field luu ket qua premium, hien phai tinh tay

mv_pq.ly_do: chi nam trong note, khong co field so nao dung sau; dan BoE Quarterly Bulletin 2014 Q1 de bac chinh khai niem — field m2.irp_link da bi xoa khoi data.js ngay 23/11

he_so_nhan_tien.ly_do: chinh field m2.multiplier ghi 'KHAI NIEM LOI THOI (Bank of England 2014 bac bo)'; giu lai chi gay nham lan — field m2.multiplier da bi xoa khoi data.js ngay 23/11

pledgeability.ly_do: them vao nhung khong khai thac; field m2.pledgeability_test va m2.obligability_ratio da bi xoa khoi data.js, chi con muc mo trong TIER_MAP

liquidity_paradox.ly_do: field m2.liquidity_paradox va m2.paradox_implication da bi xoa khoi data.js, chi con muc mo trong TIER_MAP

_quy_tac_tan_suat: Tan suat cua mo hinh = tan suat cong bo cua input CHAM NHAT trong nhom 'input'. Khong dat theo mong muon cap nhat. Neu mot input nhanh hon han phan con lai, tach thanh mo hinh rieng thay vi ha nguong ca cum.
